thread:
sara: Quick handoff — I pushed the initial IAC accelerator artifacts for the new cloud partner enablement. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-iac (root: /accelerators/cloud-partner). Please review modules + examples and call out any blocker by EOD next Wed. :rocket:
eli: Nice, thanks. Which cloud targets did we include? Azure + GCP only or AWS too?
kevin: Included all three. There's a common module + provider wrappers. Top-level layout is /modules/{refarch,network,monitoring,rbac} and /examples/{azure,gcp,aws}.
devon: Great. Are we shipping ARM/Bicep artifacts for the partner marketplace or relying purely on Terraform? Partner PM asked specifically about ARM.
sara: We added ARM and Bicep in /examples/azure/arm-bicep. Terraform is the primary delivery for infra teams but marketplace package needs ARM/Bicep for certification.
kevin: FYI module usage example in README: 
```
module "redwood_refarch" {
  source  = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-iac//modules/refarch"
  version = "v0.1.0"
  cloud   = "azure"
}
```
eli: Thanks — will wire up unit tests. What's the CI plan? GitHub Actions or internal pipelines?
sara: Use GH Actions for feature branch checks; we have a draft pipeline in .github/workflows/ci.yml that runs `terraform validate`, `tflint`, and `kitchen-terraform` smoke tests for examples. Production publish uses our internal release pipeline (templated) which calls the marketplace packaging step.
terraform-bot: Pipeline `partner-iac/ci` succeeded on branch `handoff/sara/iac-accelerator` (run: 142) :white_check_mark:
kevin: Quick question about variables — we renamed `environment` -> `deployment_env` to match partner naming. Make sure examples updated, otherwise docs will be confusing.
devon: I'll update the partner-facing README and marketplace manifest. Also adding a short diagram to the ref-arch page. Can someone add a tiny network diagram (ASCII ok) for the README?
sara: @kevin can you drop a minimal topo? just public lb -> app subnet (gpus) -> priv db. keep it small.
kevin: Dropping one now in README, also adding `example.tfvars` for each cloud so partners can plug & play.
eli: I'll add a test matrix for the examples: run terraform plan against the examples in GH Actions and mock any external services.
sara: Owners: kevin = module + examples, eli = tests + CI, devon = partner docs + marketplace manifest. I'll own release coordination and cert checklist. Target rollout: sign-off by 2026-04-08.
devon: noted. I'll draft the marketplace packaging steps and post them in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
kevin: One more: we should version module paths for registry publishing. Suggest tag `v0.1.0-partner-azure` for the initial publish and follow semantic tags after.
sara: agreed. we will also add a CHANGELOG.md and a small eval checklist for performance/regressions (latency, token throughput for inference nodes).
eli: Ping me if you need a load profile for smoke tests. I can export the sample traces we used in bench runs.
sara: perfect. Thanks all — please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your initial review. I'll compile feedback and set a follow-up sync if needed.
kevin: :white_check_mark:
devon: :white_check_mark:
